title: Project Environment Setup
body: Initialize GitHub repository and link Sanity CMS with Vercel deployment pipelines for local and cloud development.

title: Landing Page Scaffold
body: Create the base Next.js page structure with Sanity-connected placeholders for the Header Footer and Body content.

title: Site Style Guide & Wireframes
body: Define the visual language including color palettes typography and layout wireframes to guide all component development.

title: Header Component (Desktop)
body: Develop the CMS-driven navigation bar with dynamic links and 'current page' logic for desktop viewports.

title: Header Component (Mobile)
body: Implement the responsive mobile navigation menu and adaptive header layout including mobile-specific interaction logic.

title: Global Footer (Desktop)
body: Build the CMS-driven footer component with site information and links for desktop display.

title: Global Footer (Mobile)
body: Apply responsive styling to the footer for mobile devices ensuring proper stacking and readability.

title: Reusable Hero Block (Desktop)
body: Create the foundational Hero schema and component supporting text-alignment image positioning and CTA logic.

title: Reusable Hero Block (Mobile)
body: Refine the Hero Block for mobile screens ensuring images and text stack appropriately for vertical consumption.

title: Welcome Hero Section (Desktop)
body: Implement the primary Landing Hero with right-aligned imagery and welcome messaging from the CMS.

title: Welcome Hero Section (Mobile)
body: Optimize the Welcome Hero for mobile viewports with responsive scaling and centered alignment.

title: Trading Hero Section (Desktop)
body: Render the Trading-specific block with a disabled 'More to Come' CTA and left-aligned imagery.

title: Trading Hero Section (Mobile)
body: Apply mobile-specific layout rules to the Trading Hero block.

title: Technologies Hero Section (Desktop)
body: Implement the Technology block with a functional CTA linking to the Blog page.

title: Technologies Hero Section (Mobile)
body: Ensure the Technologies Hero CTA and imagery are touch-friendly and responsive.

title: Consulting Hero Section (Desktop)
body: Build the Consulting block with a CTA leading to the Contact Us page.

title: Consulting Hero Section (Mobile)
body: Apply responsive layout and vertical stacking to the Consulting Hero section.

title: Blog Page Scaffold
body: Create the 2-column layout scaffold for the blog list view inheriting the global project styles.

title: Blog Post List (Desktop)
body: Render the list of blog posts from Sanity including titles and dates in the main content column.

title: Blog Post List (Mobile)
body: Optimize the blog list for mobile including full-width list items and adjusted typography.

title: Blog Sidebar Index (Desktop)
body: Build a monthly archive jump-link sidebar grouped by year and month (descending order).

title: Blog Sidebar Index (Mobile)
body: Transform the sidebar index into a mobile-friendly dropdown menu for easier navigation on small screens.

title: Blog Search & Filters (Desktop)
body: Implement feature-flagged search and month/year filter UI placeholders in the blog header.

title: Blog Search & Filters (Mobile)
body: Adapt the search and filter UI for mobile viewports using optimized input sizes.

title: Individual Post View (Desktop)
body: Create the dynamic route for full blog articles supporting Portable Text and rich media from Sanity.

title: Individual Post View (Mobile)
body: Ensure long-form blog content is readable and responsive on mobile devices.

title: Contact Page Scaffold
body: Setup the Contact Us page layout including the header and footer placeholders.

title: Contact Form Feature (Desktop)
body: Build the full form component including validation success (Thank You) and error (Oops) states with retry logic.

title: Contact Form Feature (Mobile)
body: Optimize form fields and submission states for mobile touch interactions and keyboard overlays.

title: Vercel Deployment
body: Configure production environments on Vercel and link the main branch for automatic deployment.

title: Sanity Production Config
body: Configure production datasets API tokens and CORS settings for secure live data access.

title: CI/CD Pipeline Setup
body: Implement automated linting and testing via GitHub Actions to ensure code quality before merges.

title: Branch Protection
body: Establish Pull Request requirements and branch protection rules to safeguard the production code.

title: Live Launch Verification
body: Execute the final build and verify all live URLs and CMS connections in the production environment.

title: Localization Foundation
body: Architect the CMS and frontend to support English and Spanish content switching.

title: Advanced Navigation Buttons
body: Extend the header component to support image-background buttons and modal popup triggers.

title: Advertisement System
body: Implement pluggable ad blocks for the landing page and blog list with configurable frequency.

title: Member Authentication
body: Develop the service layer for user accounts and permission-based CMS editing access.
